# age_encrypted (Ephemeral Resource)

Encrypts `plaintext` to one or more age recipients without storing the plaintext or the ciphertext in state or plan.

age encryption is randomized, so the ciphertext differs every time the ephemeral resource is opened, which is on every plan and apply. Use it with ephemeral inputs (`ephemeral.age_identity`, `ephemeral.random_bytes`) and pass the ciphertext to a write-only argument.

Requires OpenTofu 1.11 or Terraform 1.10 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Wrap a random data-encryption key with a post-quantum identity, the way Klio
# (CloudNativePG backups) expects its encryption key file, and store both in
# 1Password. Neither the key, the identity nor the ciphertext reaches state.
#
# The identity and the ciphertext come from the same run, so they always match.
# Both write-only versions must change together: bumping only one stores an
# identity that can't open the stored ciphertext.
ephemeral "random_bytes" "data_key" {
  length = 32
}

ephemeral "age_identity" "backup" {
  post_quantum = true
}

ephemeral "age_encrypted" "data_key" {
  plaintext  = ephemeral.random_bytes.data_key.hex
  recipients = [ephemeral.age_identity.backup.recipient]
}

locals {
  # Bumping this generates a new data key: everything encrypted with the old
  # one becomes unreadable.
  key_version = 1
}

# The password category keeps both the password and the note; secure_note
# drops the password.
resource "onepassword_item" "klio_encryption" {
  vault    = var.vault_id
  title    = "klio-encryption"
  category = "password"

  password_wo           = ephemeral.age_identity.backup.identity
  password_wo_version   = local.key_version
  note_value_wo         = ephemeral.age_encrypted.data_key.ciphertext
  note_value_wo_version = local.key_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plaintext` (String, Sensitive) The data to encrypt.
- `recipients` (List of String) age recipients, X25519 (`age1...`) or post-quantum (`age1pq1...`). Any of the matching identities can decrypt. The two kinds can't be mixed in one list.

### Read-Only

- `ciphertext` (String) The ciphertext, ASCII-armored (`-----BEGIN AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----`). Multi-line.
- `ciphertext_base64` (String) The binary ciphertext, base64-encoded on a single line. Useful for stores that don't preserve newlines.
- `id` (String) SHA-256 of the binary ciphertext.
